notes: Tin ores and concentrates (HS 2609), 2024 (BACI, baci): world 0.12 Mt gross weight; top exporters COD 0.03 Mt, AUS 0.02 Mt, NGA 0.02 Mt.
Trade tables are unwrought tin (HS 8001, alloyed or not; waste and scrap, HS 8002, are not included) in kt; production and reserves are contained tin (t Sn). No tin lanes exist (no seaborne figure).
Myanmar ranks 8 in the USGS production table (12,000 t Sn in 2025); mining in Wa State, its main tin area, was suspended from 1 August 2023 (see the events).

Republic of the Congo is recorded as an exporter of tin concentrate (7.7 kt in 2024, 18,887 USD/t) but is not a tin producer in the USGS table, while DR Congo is (17,732 USD/t). Relabelling of DR Congo material is a possible cause; it is not established here.
discrepancies: NLD->HUN: 3.13 kt of tin-metal in 2024 (reported tonnage implies 416 USD/t, i.e. 0.0139x the tin-metal group-year median unit value: possible misreport, kept because the flow is below the 50 M USD correction rule).

Tin concentrate from Myanmar to China, 2024: customs data (BACI, HS 2609) record 0.0 kt from Myanmar and 92.1 kt for China's imports from all origins. Chinese customs figures reported by SMM (Shanghai Metals Market), 23 December 2024, quoting China's General Administration of Customs, give about 150.8 kt of tin ores and concentrates imported in January to November 2024, 75.3 kt of it from Myanmar (https://news.metal.com/en/newscontent/103438801). The Myanmar flow is missing from the BACI extract and the world figure for tin concentrate is probably too low; the cause is not established here. Comparing with China's own import declarations (UN Comtrade) needs an API key that the atlas does not have.
